clips.intro: Welcome to your English practice for units one and two. Listen carefully, and write your answers. You can play each recording again.
clips.l5: Some children spend all their pocket money. Others save some of it. We should learn to use our pocket money well.
clips.l6: We may have different ideas, but we should always tell the truth. We should always tell the truth.
clips.l7: In my opinion, doing exercise every day is good for our health. Doing exercise every day is good for our health.
clips.l8: On Saturday, Ben went to a shop with twenty yuan. The notebook had a price of twelve yuan on it, but the shopkeeper said, Today it is only ten yuan. Ben bought one notebook and paid with a twenty-yuan banknote. He got ten yuan in change. Then he donated four yuan to a charity to help people in need. He put the other six yuan in his wallet.
